run_evaluate_zeroshot_retrieval: run the evaluate function to compute zero-shot retrieval recall metrics for a CLIP-like model on a dataset
run_get_pe_av_embeddings: run get_pe_av_embeddings to encode text, audio, or video inputs using a PEAudioVisual model
run_recall_at_k: run recall_at_k to compute recall at k for text-media retrieval using a compatibility score matrix
run_batchify: run batchify to apply a function in batches over two tensors for memory-efficient computation
run_dataloader_with_indices: run dataloader_with_indices to wrap a dataloader and yield samples with their batch indices
